This template is used for creating colored text without the need to use CSS "span" or "div" tags.

==Syntax==
The syntax of this template must be typed like this:<br>
<code><nowiki>{{colortext|COLOR|Displayed Text}}</nowiki></code><br><br>

There are two ways to apply color: either by using a color name that is recognized by the HTML in a browser (such as "red", "lime" or "darkgrey"), or by using a hex code such as "#550000" (which is dark red) or "#0000ff" (which is blue). Note that adding another two numbers will have those numbers control the opacity of the text.<br><br>
Typing the following: <code><nowiki>{{colortext|#ff0080|This is very noticable fushia text.}}</nowiki></code><br>
Will produce this: {{colortext|#ff0080|This is very noticable fushia text.}}<br><br>
Note that text can be formatted within the template: <code><nowiki>{{colortext|#0072ED|'''''This navy blue text has both bolds and italics.'''''}}</nowiki></code><br>
Which produces this: {{colortext|#0072ED|'''''This navy blue text has both bolds and italics.'''''}}
